title: Implement Queue using Stacks
summary: Implement MyQueue using only stack operations.

contractDetails.constraints: At most 100 method calls. 1 ≤ x ≤ 9. pop and peek only occur when nonempty. Rows [0,x], [1], [2], [3] mean push, pop, peek, empty. Construct once. Serialize query returns in order, encoding booleans as 0 or 1.
contractDetails.output-checking: Construct MyQueue once. [0,x] calls push, [1] pop, [2] peek, [3] empty. Serialize non-void returns in order. Encode bool returns as integer 0 or 1.

statement: Implement MyQueue using only stack operations. push(x) appends a value, pop() removes and returns the oldest value, peek() reads it, and empty() reports whether no values remain. A stack may only push, pop, read its top, and report size or emptiness.

examples.explanation: The first pushed value leaves first.

constraints: At most 100 method calls. 1 ≤ x ≤ 9. pop and peek only occur when nonempty. Rows [0,x], [1], [2], [3] mean push, pop, peek, empty. Construct once. Serialize query returns in order, encoding booleans as 0 or 1.
hints: Conceptual: Moving all entries between stacks reverses their order.
Directional: Keep incoming values separate from values ready to leave.
Implementation: Transfer the incoming stack to the outgoing stack only when the outgoing stack is empty.
complexityAnalysis: O(1) amortized per method, O(n) worst-case transfer time, O(n) storage.
